title: Structural properties of graphs and the Universal Difference Property
summary: We study the Universal Difference Property (UDP) introduced by Altınok, Anders, Arreola, Asencio, Ireland, Sarıoğlan, and Smith, focusing on the relationship between the structural properties of a graph and UDP. We present condtions for when UDP must hold on unicyclic graphs. We then prove that if UDP does not hold on an edge-labeled graph, then it cannot hold on any subdivision of that graph. Additionally, we show that if an edge-labeled graph satisfies the pairwise edge-disjoint path property, then the graph satisfies UDP.
